title: A Community Repair Café
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。短文是一篇模拟教育材料，不是官方雅思试题。请仔细阅读，答案必须来自短文。
passage:
A Community Repair Café

(A) Every Saturday morning, a group of volunteers opens a repair café in the community hall. People bring broken items from home: lamps, chairs, radios, and small machines. The volunteers try to fix them for free. The café started two years ago when a retired engineer named Mr. Chen wanted to help his neighbours. He believed that many things could be repaired instead of thrown away.

(B) Last Saturday, Mrs. Li brought a lamp that did not turn on. A volunteer named Anna checked the lamp and found a loose wire. She fixed it in ten minutes. Mrs. Li was very happy because she did not need to buy a new lamp. Another visitor, Tom, brought a chair with a broken leg. Two volunteers worked together to repair it. They used wood glue and a metal plate. Tom said, “This chair is older than me, but now it is strong again.”

(C) The café also teaches people how to repair things themselves. Every week, there is a short workshop. Last week, the workshop was about changing a plug. About fifteen people attended. The volunteers explained that safety is the most important thing. They showed everyone how to turn off the power before starting. Many people asked questions, and the volunteers answered them patiently.

(D) The repair café is not just about fixing objects. It is also a place where neighbours meet and talk. Some people come just for a cup of tea and a chat. Mr. Chen says, “We save money and reduce waste, but the best part is the friendships.” The café is open from 9 a.m. to 12 p.m. every Saturday. It is free, but donations are welcome. Next month, the café will celebrate its second anniversary with a small party.

grammar.title: 基础时态、问句、名词数量和常见从句综合复习
grammar.explanation: 英语中，一般现在时表示经常发生的动作或事实，一般过去时表示过去发生的动作。问句通常把助动词放在主语前。名词有可数和不可数之分，可数名词有单复数变化。从句可以用来补充信息，如宾语从句和定语从句。
grammar.example: The café started two years ago when a retired engineer named Mr. Chen wanted to help his neighbours.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question: ______ does the café open?
questions.explanation: 询问时间用“What time”。
questions.evidence: The café is open from 9 a.m. to 12 p.m.

questions.prompt: Last Saturday, Mrs. Li ______ a lamp to the café.
questions.explanation: Last Saturday 表示过去时间，动词用过去式 brought。
questions.evidence: Last Saturday, Mrs. Li brought a lamp that did not turn on.

questions.prompt: There ______ about fifteen people at the workshop last week.
questions.explanation: people 是复数，且 last week 表示过去，所以用 were。
questions.evidence: About fifteen people attended.

questions.prompt: The volunteer ______ fixed the lamp is named Anna.
questions.explanation: 先行词 volunteer 指人，定语从句用 who。
questions.evidence: A volunteer named Anna checked the lamp and found a loose wire.
